items.name: theme
items.title: dylo theme
items.description: Design tokens plus the Tailwind v4 mapping that turns them into utilities: bg-ink, text-oxide, border-line, font-mono, shadow-block. Start here in every project.

items.name: catalyst-theme
items.title: dylo theme for Catalyst
items.description: Remaps Tailwind's zinc and blue scales onto the dylo palette so every existing Catalyst component renders warm. Import after dylo-theme.css.

items.name: fonts
items.title: dylo webfonts
items.description: Space Grotesk and Space Mono over the Google Fonts CDN, for consumers without a font pipeline. Must be the first line of your stylesheet. Next.js apps should use next/font instead.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The mono section label with an oxide tick. The brand's most recognizable device, and the one that spends the view's single accent.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Foundry-stamped action. An ink plate with a hard block shadow that seats on press.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with a mono uppercase label and the oxide focus ring. Stays a Server Component.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status or technical chip in mono type. Square-ish, part of the engineered layer.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The signature foundry panel: ink border plus a hard block-shadow offset, barely rounded.

items.name: website-kit
items.title: Marketing site
items.description: The dylo homepage in six composable sections: sticky nav, hero on the engineering grid, work grid, studio steps, contact form and footer.
